governed_update.storage: Persistent native SQLite; synchronous top-level IMMEDIATE transactions, foreign keys, safe journal and enabled synchronous required
governed_update.authorization: Current authenticated actor, trusted sender/frame, generation, active organization membership, actual board/task relationship and current role permission; native-window and database/file/context capability binding for execution
governed_update.version: SHA-256 of full bounded task row, exact selected board metadata and monotonic safe-integer revision; production insert/update/delete triggers preserve tombstones across ID deletion/reuse and ID changes
governed_update.trigger_profile: Exact production revision triggers required; additional persistent or TEMP triggers on tasks, revisions, update Runs or activity refused before and after writes
governed_update.confirmation: Existing shared ApprovalGate strict/high, one native dialog operation per vault, default cancel, escaped identity/IDs and changed before/after fields; running persisted before dialog
atomic_success: standard succeeded ActionRun and classified metadata evidence
governed_update.idempotency: Client UUIDv4 nonce; metadata-only persisted digests; same nonce only reads recorded outcomes and never reopens native dialog for running/unknown/succeeded; queued capabilities are process-local and cannot survive restart
governed_update.unresolved: One running/unknown execution fence per task; separate unresolvedRun returned beyond history pagination; queued previews do not own the execution fence
governed_update.cancellation: Current update permission for own pending record; another actor additionally needs board.task.action.cancel (existing wildcard semantics apply); seals queued/running/unknown and rejects late mutation without claiming to dismiss an open OS dialog
governed_update.privacy: Run/evidence/activity omit source and proposed body and raw nonce; preview body/context remain short-term main-process memory without guaranteed timed physical erasure
